resolved from the frozen plan as the sole cell whose dependency_keys contain the halted sequential cell

note: Append-only. Excludes from execution convergence only, never from reporting.
signature: checker_malformed: the frozen checker returned the empty string, memoised by the per-call cache, so every resume replays it.
why_this_one_matters_more: Unlike the first terminal halt (placebo_b2, no dependents), this is a sequential_b2 cell with a batch_same_qa_b2 dependent. Both are conditions the primary estimands difference, and losing a matched pair removes support from P and R together. The missing-data policy requires the whole matched set to leave all three estimands rather than each arm dropping independently, so H = P + R still holds on common support.
